_comment: Real corrections, newest first. Every entry must name the pages, the date the fix shipped, and what changed vs what did not. This file is the only source for the corrections log on /sources/ and /changelog/ and for each page's 'last changed' date and the changelog's 'last updated'; do not hand-write a 'no corrections yet' claim anywhere.

entries.what: The tyre-pressure quick answer printed “Infinity–-Infinity psi”. The range was computed from an empty list: this model year prints no tyre-pressure table at all, so all three tyre rows carried a size and no pressure, and the minimum of nothing is Infinity. The same page also said in one panel that the manual lists three pressure rows and, in the next, that it prints no pressure table. The quick answer now reads “On the door-jamb label”, and the sentence about pressure rows only appears on pages that actually have pressures. Separately, the configuration selector now offers both oil figures (4.2 qt FWD, 5.3 qt AWD) — it was collapsing two drivetrain-specific capacities into one engine and only the FWD figure was reachable.
entries.unchanged: The three tyre sizes, both oil capacities, the viscosity, the towing figure and all five recalls. No underlying value was wrong: the page was printing a computed artefact and two contradictory sentences.

entries.what: The oil capacity was missing from the “find the numbers for your build” selector on both pages. A capacity row reading “1.5L turbo (non-hybrid)” was classified as a hybrid figure because the text contains the word hybrid, and a page-level note naming both “gasoline and hybrid engines” was being read as if it applied to each row individually. Neither figure then matched any engine, so the selector showed nothing. The hybrid test now excludes “non-hybrid” and each row is classified on its own wording.
entries.unchanged: Both capacities were correct on the pages themselves and in the oil table; only the selector's pairing was wrong.

entries.what: The page illustrated a 2024 RAV4 Hybrid Woodland Edition while its oil capacity applies to the 2.5L gasoline engine only. The caption now names the powertrain difference in the same sentence as the photo credit, and the oil figure is stated only after an engine is chosen.
entries.unchanged: Oil capacity (4.5 qt with filter / 4.2 qt without) and every tire row: figures were correct and are unchanged.

entries.what: Four citations pointed at a query-string address on carcare.org (?p=65 and ?p=68) that no longer returns the article. They now point at the articles' own permalinks.
entries.unchanged: The quoted wording from those pages is unchanged; only the link resolves differently.

entries.what: The oil quick answer printed an empty placeholder instead of the without-filter figure for the 2020 and 2024 RAV4. Two copies of the capacity parser disagreed about the unlabelled "with / without" pair in the manual. The page now uses one parser that merges the pair.
entries.unchanged: The figures themselves were already correct in the source and on the full table.

entries.what: Meta descriptions kept a bare engine label after the viscosity grade was stripped, reading '… with filter, 2.5L 4-cylinder'. The label is now removed with the grade.
entries.unchanged: Visible page text and every published figure.
